+    body = (
+        model.body
+        if runtime["compile"] == "eager"
+        else torch.compile(model.body, mode=runtime["compile"], dynamic=False)
+    )
+

+    loss_fn = (
+        compiled_loss
+        if runtime["compile"] == "eager"

+    )

+        if runtime["head"] == "triton":
+            return head_ce.HeadCE.apply(h, model.head.weight, target.reshape(-1))

+
+    model.forward = forward_loss

+        run = nn.parallel.DistributedDataParallel(

+        )
+    armed = {"value": False}
+

+        if armed["value"]:
+            armed["value"] = False
+            fast.begin()
+
+    if fast and config["root"]["begin"] == "head":
+        model.head.weight.register_post_accumulate_grad_hook(begin_hook)
+    mixture = MarinMixture(
+        args.data,
+        weights=config["data"]["mixture_weights"],
+        seq=seq,
+        seed=t.get("seed", 0),
+        heldout_windows=t["heldout_windows"],
+    )
+    evaluation = eval_sets(args.data, include=["c4_en"], seq=seq)
+    if "paloma/c4_en" not in evaluation:
+        raise ValueError("Missing Paloma C4 shards under DATA/paloma/c4_en")
+    cap = micro * seq // 2 + 1
+
+    def to_device(tokens):
+        tok, target, cu, meta = pack(tokens, cap, config["data"]["eos_token_id"])
+        return (
+            tok.to(device, non_blocking=True),
+            target.to(device, non_blocking=True),
+            cu.to(device, non_blocking=True),
+            meta,
+        )
+
+    def evaluate(dataset):
+        n = len(dataset)
+        if runtime["eval_max_windows"]:
+            n = min(n, runtime["eval_max_windows"])
+        per_rank = math.ceil(n / world)
+        total = torch.zeros(2, dtype=torch.float64, device=device)
+        # Use the training graph, then detach, to keep its BF16 rounding and compilation path.
+        for offset in range(0, per_rank, micro):
+            start = rank * per_rank + offset
+            real = max(0, min(micro, per_rank - offset, n - start))
+            tokens = dataset.batch(start, real) if real else np.empty((0, seq), dtype=np.uint32)
+            if real < micro:
+                tokens = np.concatenate(
+                    (tokens, np.repeat(dataset.batch(0, 1), micro - real, axis=0))
+                )
+            tok, target, cu, meta = to_device(tokens)
+            with torch.autocast("cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16):
+                h = body(tok, cu, meta).to(torch.bfloat16).detach().reshape(-1, m["hidden"])
+                _, _, losses = head_ce.head_ce_forward(
+                    h, model.head.weight.to(torch.bfloat16), target.reshape(-1)
+                )
+            total[0] += losses.reshape(micro, seq)[:real].double().sum()
+            total[1] += (target[:real] != -100).sum()
+        if world > 1:
+            dist.all_reduce(total)
+        return (total[0] / total[1]).item()
+
+    args.out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    if rank == 0:
+        (args.out / "config.json").write_text(json.dumps(config, indent=2) + "\n")
+    steps = min(t["steps"], args.max_steps) if args.max_steps else t["steps"]
+    for step in range(steps):
+        model.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
+        for optimizer in optimizers:
+            for group in optimizer.param_groups:
+                group["lr"] = group["base_lr"] * schedule_factor(step, config["schedule"])
+        loss_sum = torch.zeros((), device=device)
+        for i in range(accumulation):
+            if world > 1:
+                run.require_backward_grad_sync = i == accumulation - 1
+            if fast:
+                if chunk < accumulation and i % chunk == 0 and i:
+                    fast.chunk_wait()
+                model.body.stat_at.copy_(
+                    torch.arange((i % chunk) * rows, (i % chunk + 1) * rows, device=device)
+                )
+            start = step * batch + (rank * accumulation + i) * micro
+            packed = to_device(mixture.batch(start, micro))
+            with torch.autocast("cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16):
+                loss = run(*packed)
+            if fast and chunk < accumulation and (i + 1) % chunk == 0 and i < accumulation - 1:
+                fast.chunk_stats()

+                if config["root"]["begin"] == "head":
+                    armed["value"] = True
+                else:

+            optimizer.step()

+            dist.all_reduce(loss_sum)

+        if step % runtime["eval_every"] == 0 or step + 1 == steps:
+            metrics["c4_loss"] = evaluate(evaluation["paloma/c4_en"])
+        if rank == 0:
+            print(json.dumps(metrics), flush=True)
+            with (args.out / "metrics.jsonl").open("a") as stream:
+                stream.write(json.dumps(metrics) + "\n")
+    if rank == 0:
+        torch.save(
+            {"model": model.state_dict(), "step": steps, "config": config}, args.out / "model.pt"
+        )
+    if fast:
+        fast.side.synchronize()
+        fast.pool.shutdown(wait=True)
+    if world > 1:
+        dist.destroy_process_group()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+# Figure 12 hyperparameters
+
+Figure 12 compares optimizers on nanoGPT/FineWeb at approximately 1.7B tokens.
+Learning rates below are the values applied to the hidden weight matrices.
+The dashed baselines in the figure are published results from Dang et al.;
+the runnable Muon configs in this repository reproduce our local controls.
+
+## MuonT
+
+The [loadable reproduction configs](README.md#training) include all settings.
+MuonT uses strengths (½, ⅛), momentum 0.95 with Nesterov, input-statistic
+momentum 0.95 and damping 0.001. All learning rates stay constant before the cooldown, then decay linearly
+to zero. The cooldown fraction varies by batch, as shown below.
+
+| Batch | Matrix LR | Shaped weight decay | Cooldown fraction | Config |
+|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
+| 128K | 0.017678 | 0.025 | 0.8 | [JSON](configs/muont_128k.json) |
+| 512K | 0.035355 | 0.05 | 0.7 | [JSON](configs/muont_512k.json) |
+| 1M | 0.035355 | 0.1 | 0.8 | [JSON](configs/muont_1m.json) |
+| 2M | 0.035355 | 0.1 | 0.4 | [JSON](configs/muont_2m.json) |
+
+## AdamT
+
+AdamT uses strengths (¼, ¼), damping 0.001, Adam epsilon 1e-10 and
+**input-statistic momentum 0.938** in these experiments. This explicit setting
+differs from the library default, which now follows beta2. All learning rates
+warm up linearly, stay constant, then decay linearly during the final 40% of
+training at 128K–1M, or the final 60% at 2M. Auxiliary parameters use AdamW with zero weight decay.
+
+| Batch | Matrix LR | Shaped weight decay | Matrix betas | Warmup updates |
+|---|---:|---:|---|---:|
+| 128K | 0.0010607 | 0.3 | (0.94, 0.94903) | 1000 |
+| 512K | 0.0021213 | 0.6 | (0.9, 0.85858) | 250 |
+| 1M | 0.0021213 | 0.8 | (0.85858, 0.93106) | 125 |
+| 2M | 0.003 | 1.8 | (0.9, 0.86884) | 63 |
+
+| Batch | Embedding LR | Head LR | Scalar LR | Auxiliary betas |
+|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
+| 128K | 0.84853 | 0.0088388 | 0.0282843 | (0.71716, 0.9955) |
+| 512K | 0.84853 | 0.0088388 | 0.0282843 | (0.85858, 0.975) |
+| 1M | 0.6 | 0.00625 | 0.02 | (0.85858, 0.9025) |
+| 2M | 3.3941 | 0.0353553 | 0.113137 | (0.92929, 0.96721) |
+
+[Recorded AdamT settings](figure12_adamt_settings.json) also specify
+sampling and refresh settings. The 128K runs pool statistics once per step and
+refresh cached factors through staggered background submissions every 16
+updates after 200 initial updates; new factors are installed on the next update.
+The larger batches use rank-local statistics updated per forward, adjusting
+the EMA coefficient for accumulation, and refresh factors every step.
+These are settings for the
+plotted implementation; the current nanoGPT reproduction runner supports Muon
+and MuonT, so this AdamT file is not a runnable trainer config.

+# Reproduce the nanoGPT comparison
+
+These configurations train the same 162M-parameter modded-nanoGPT model with
+Muon or MuonT at 128K, 512K, 1M and 2M tokens per update. They specify the model, initialization,
+optimizer arithmetic, data order, schedule, and evaluation settings.
+
+## Data
+
+```bash
+python reproduce/nanogpt/download_data.py --out data/fineweb10B
+```
+
+The downloader uses [FineWeb10B tokenized with GPT-2](https://huggingface.co/datasets/kjj0/fineweb10B-gpt2)
+at revision `889765ea1f903759787add96995d81171b632d0c` and verifies all 33 files
+against `data.sha256`. The download is approximately 6.6 GB. To verify an
+existing copy, add `--check-only`.
+
+Use this exact shard set. Adding more shards changes the training sequence. Sequence rows remain
+contiguous within each shard.
+
+## Training
+
+Install the package with `pip install -e '.[examples,fast]'`, then run on four
+CUDA GPUs:
+

+        for m in mods:
+            by_n.setdefault(m.stat_cov.size(0), []).append(m)
+        self.groups = [RootGroup(ms) for n, ms in sorted(by_n.items(), reverse=True)]
+        self.where = {m: (g, j) for g in self.groups for j, m in enumerate(g.modules)}
+

+        ready.record()

+            root_host_basis, snap, ready, snap.device, self.copy_stream, self.side

+        wide = sum((len(g.pending) for g in self.groups if g.wide))
+        cand = []
+        for gi, g in enumerate(self.groups):
+            for j in range(len(g.modules)):
+                age = self.steps - g.age[j]
+                if j in g.pending:
+                    continue
+                if j in g.flagged:
+                    cand.append((int(g.wide), -age, gi, j))

+            if free <= 0:

+            if g.wide and wide >= ROOT_WIDE_MAX:
+                continue
+            self._refresh(g, j)
+            free -= 1
+            wide += int(g.wide)
+
+    def _products(self, g):
+        Rb, Rhat, m2 = ({}, {}, {})
+        R = {}
+        for q in ROOT_USE:
+            parts = root_split(q)
+            Rq = g.Rs[parts[0]]
+            for b in parts[1:]:
+                Rq = root_bmm32(Rq.half(), g.Rs[b].half())
+            R[q] = Rq
+            Rb[q], Rhat[q], m2[q] = root_products(Rq)

+        if ROOT_DEC_ROOT and _ROOT_D8:
+            Rh = R[ROOT_DEC_ROOT].half()
+            P = root_decay(root_bmm32(Rh, Rh), m2[ROOT_DEC_ROOT])

+
+    def _fast_body(self, g):

+        fin = torch.isfinite(est) & torch.isfinite(lam).all(-1) & (rho <= ROOT_RHO_MAX)
+        D, sc, ests = ({}, {}, [])
+        for p in ROOT_POWERS:
+            if p == 0.25:
+                D[p] = root_y(lam, O)
+                ests.append(est)
+            elif p == 0.5:
+                D[p] = root_y2(lam, O, root_bmm32(Ob, Ob))
+                ests.append(2.0 * est)
+            elif p == 1.0:

+            else:
+                s, Q, est_s = root_sqrt(lam, O, ROOT_SQRT_ITERS)

+        e = torch.stack(ests).amax(0)
+        fin = fin & torch.isfinite(e)
+        good, usable = (fin & (e <= ROOT_TOL), fin & (e <= 10 * ROOT_TOL))
+        for p in ROOT_POWERS:
+            Rn = root_form(g.basis, D[p])
+            root_select(usable, root_rescale(Rn, sc[p]) if p in sc else Rn, g.Rs[p])
+        root_keep(usable, Bs, lam, O, g.Bp, g.lamp, g.Op, g.warm_ok)
+        g.cnt += torch.stack([~good, ~usable, ~torch.isfinite(e)]).int()
+        torch.maximum(
+            g.mx,
+            torch.stack([rho, torch.where(torch.isfinite(e), e, 0.0)]).nan_to_num(1e30),
+            out=g.mx,
+        )
+        flags = (~good).to(torch.uint8) + 2 * (~usable).to(torch.uint8)
+        return self._products(g) + (flags,)

+    def _fast(self, g, main):
+        exact_now = []
+        if g.flags_ev is not None and g.flags_ev.query():

+                if f:
+                    g.flagged.append(j)
+                if g.unusable_run[j] >= ROOT_STALE_MAX:
+                    exact_now.append(j)
+                    g.unusable_run[j] = 0
+            g.flags_ev = None
+        if exact_now:
+            self.diag["fallback"] += len(exact_now)
+            fidx = torch.tensor(exact_now, device=g.C.device)
+            V, Rf = root_exact(g.C[fidx], ROOT_POWERS)
+            SB, S2 = (_root_rows_lo(V), _root_cols_hi(V))
+            for i, j in enumerate(exact_now):
+                g.basis.install(j, SB[i], S2[i])
+                g.warm_ok[j : j + 1].zero_()
+                g.age[j] = self.steps
+                for p in ROOT_POWERS:
+                    g.Rs[p][j].copy_(Rf[p][i])

+                + list(g.out[1].values())

+            ):

+    @torch.no_grad()

+            for j in [j for j, f in g.pending.items() if f.done()]:
+                SB, S2, done, wall = g.pending.pop(j).result()
+                torch.cuda.current_stream().wait_event(done)
+                if g.basis is not None:
+                    g.basis.install(j, SB, S2)
+                    g.warm_ok[j : j + 1].zero_()
+                    g.age[j] = g.snap_step.pop(j, self.steps)
+                    self.diag["installed"] += 1

+                continue

+                        g.basis = RootBasis(V)

+                        g.basis.set_all(V)

+                for p in ROOT_POWERS:
+                    g.Rs[p].copy_(R[p])
+                g.Rb, g.Rhat, g.P = self._products(g)
+                for t in (
+                    list(g.Rb.values()) + list(g.Rhat.values()) + ([g.P] if g.P is not None else [])
+                ):
+                    t.record_stream(main)

+                self._fast(g, main)
+            self._lap("roots")
+        self._lap("check")
+        if (
+            ROOT_ROOTS == "fast"
+            and self.pool is not None
+            and (self.steps >= ROOT_INLINE - 1)
+            and ROOT_POWERS
+        ):
+            self._schedule()
+        self._lap("schedule")
+
+    @torch.no_grad()
+    def begin(self):
+        t0 = self._t0 = time.perf_counter()
+        if self.groups is None:
+            params = self.param_groups[0]["params"]
+            self._setup(params[dist.get_rank() :: dist.get_world_size()])
+        main = torch.cuda.current_stream()
+        ev = torch.cuda.Event()
+        ev.record(main)
+        with torch.cuda.stream(self.side):
+            self.side.wait_event(ev)
+            self._lap("setup")
+            root_flush(self)
+            self._lap("flush")
+            self.roots(main)
+            self.done = torch.cuda.Event()
+            self.done.record(self.side)

+        dt = 1000.0 * (time.perf_counter() - t0)

+        self.diag["host_max"] = max(self.diag["host_max"], dt)
+
+    @torch.no_grad()
+    def step(self):

+            params = group["params"]
+            padded = params + [torch.empty_like(params[-1])] * (world - len(params) % world)
+            for first in range(0, len(params), world):

+                    state = self.state[parameter]
+                    if "momentum" not in state:

+                    roots, index = self.where[self.sources[parameter]]
+                    inner = roots.Rb[ROOT_P_IN][index] if ROOT_P_IN else None
+                    outer = roots.Rhat[ROOT_P_OUT][index] if ROOT_P_OUT else None

+                    else:
+                        parameter.mul_(1 - group["lr"] * group["weight_decay"])
+                    parameter.add_(update, alpha=-group["lr"])
+                dist.all_gather(padded[first : first + world], padded[first + rank])
+        self.steps += 1
+
+    def close(self):
+        if self.pool is not None:
+            self.pool.shutdown(wait=True)
+        self.side.synchronize()
+        self.copy_stream.synchronize()

+"""FineWeb token shards with the 256-int32 header format."""
+
+from pathlib import Path
+import glob
+import random
+import torch
+
+
+def load_shard(path, pin_memory=False):
+    path = Path(path)
+    header = torch.from_file(str(path), False, 256, dtype=torch.int32)
+    if header.numel() != 256 or header[0] != 20240520 or header[1] != 1:
+        raise ValueError(f"Invalid token-shard header: {path}")
+    count = int(header[2])
+    if count < 1 or path.stat().st_size != 1024 + 2 * count:
+        raise ValueError(f"Token count does not match file size: {path}")
+    tokens = torch.empty(count, dtype=torch.uint16, pin_memory=pin_memory)
+    with path.open("rb", buffering=0) as file:
+        file.seek(1024)
+        if file.readinto(tokens.numpy()) != 2 * count:
+            raise ValueError("Incomplete token shard")
+    return tokens
+
+
+def token_batches(
+    pattern, batch_tokens, sequence_length=1024, world_size=1, rank=0, device="cpu", shuffle_seed=0
+):
+    files = sorted(
+        Path(x) for x in (glob.glob(str(pattern)) if isinstance(pattern, (str, Path)) else pattern)
+    )
+    if not files:
+        raise ValueError("No token shards found")
+    if shuffle_seed:
+        random.Random(shuffle_seed).shuffle(files)
+    if (
+        not 0 <= rank < world_size
+        or batch_tokens % world_size
+        or (batch_tokens // world_size) % sequence_length
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("Batch tokens must divide into rank-local sequences")
+    local = batch_tokens // world_size
+    file_iter = iter(files)
+    tokens, pos = load_shard(next(file_iter), pin_memory=str(device).startswith("cuda")), 0
+    while True:
+        if pos + batch_tokens + 1 >= len(tokens):
+            tokens, pos = load_shard(next(file_iter), pin_memory=str(device).startswith("cuda")), 0
+        if len(tokens) < batch_tokens + 1:
+            raise ValueError("Shard cannot hold one global batch")
+        buf = tokens[pos + rank * local :][: local + 1]
+        inputs = buf[:-1].to(device=device, dtype=torch.int32, non_blocking=True)
+        targets = buf[1:].to(device=device, dtype=torch.int64, non_blocking=True)
+        pos += batch_tokens
+        yield inputs.view(-1, sequence_length), targets.view(-1, sequence_length)

+"""Download and verify the FineWeb shards used by the nanoGPT configurations."""
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+from pathlib import Path
+from urllib.request import urlopen
+
+REVISION = "889765ea1f903759787add96995d81171b632d0c"
+BASE_URL = f"https://huggingface.co/datasets/kjj0/fineweb10B-gpt2/resolve/{REVISION}"
+
+
+def sha256(path):
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open("rb") as file:
+        for chunk in iter(lambda: file.read(8 * 1024 * 1024), b""):
+            digest.update(chunk)
+    return digest.hexdigest()
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--out", type=Path, default=Path("data/fineweb10B"))
+    parser.add_argument("--check-only", action="store_true")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    entries = [
+        line.split()
+        for line in Path(__file__).with_name("data.sha256").read_text().splitlines()
+        if line.strip() and not line.startswith("#")
+    ]
+    args.out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    for expected, name in entries:
+        if Path(name).name != name:
+            raise ValueError("Shard names must be plain filenames")
+        target = args.out / name
+        if target.is_file() and sha256(target) == expected:
+            print(f"verified {name}", flush=True)
+            continue
+        if args.check_only:
+            raise SystemExit(f"Missing or mismatched shard: {target}")
+        partial = target.with_suffix(target.suffix + ".part")
+        print(f"downloading {name}", flush=True)
+        try:
+            with urlopen(f"{BASE_URL}/{name}", timeout=120) as response, partial.open("wb") as file:
+                while chunk := response.read(8 * 1024 * 1024):
+                    file.write(chunk)
+            if sha256(partial) != expected:
+                raise RuntimeError(f"Checksum mismatch for {name}")
+            partial.replace(target)
+        finally:
+            partial.unlink(missing_ok=True)
+    print(f"All {len(entries)} shards verified.")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+"""Modded-nanoGPT architecture for the reproduction configurations."""
+
+import torch
+from torch import Tensor, nn
+from torch.nn import functional as F
+
+
+class RMSNorm(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, dim):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.gains = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(dim))
+
+    def forward(self, x):
+        return F.rms_norm(x, (x.size(-1),), weight=self.gains.type_as(x))
+
+
+class Linear(nn.Linear):
+    def __init__(self, in_features, out_features):
+        super().__init__(in_features, out_features, bias=True)
+
+    def forward(self, x):
+        return F.linear(x, self.weight.type_as(x), self.bias.type_as(x))
+
+
+class Rotary(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, dim: int):
+        super().__init__()
+        angular_freq = (1 / 1024) ** torch.linspace(0, 1, steps=dim // 4, dtype=torch.float32)
+        self.register_buffer(
+            "angular_freq", torch.cat([angular_freq, angular_freq.new_zeros(dim // 4)])
+        )
+
+    def forward(self, x_BTHD: Tensor):
+        pos = torch.arange(x_BTHD.size(1), dtype=torch.float32, device=x_BTHD.device)
+        theta = torch.outer(pos, self.angular_freq)[None, :, None, :]
+        cos, sin = (theta.cos(), theta.sin())
+        x1, x2 = x_BTHD.to(dtype=torch.float32).chunk(2, dim=-1)
+        y1 = x1 * cos + x2 * sin
+        y2 = x1 * -sin + x2 * cos
+        return torch.cat((y1, y2), 3).type_as(x_BTHD)
+
+
+class CausalSelfAttention(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, dim: int, head_dim=128):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.num_heads = dim // head_dim
+        self.head_dim = head_dim
+        hdim = self.num_heads * self.head_dim
+        self.q = Linear(dim, hdim)
+        self.k = Linear(dim, hdim)
+        self.v = Linear(dim, hdim)
+        self.proj = Linear(hdim, dim)
+        self.rotary = Rotary(head_dim)
+
+    def forward(self, x: Tensor):
+        B, T = (x.size(0), x.size(1))
+        q = self.q(x).view(B, T, self.num_heads, self.head_dim)
+        k = self.k(x).view(B, T, self.num_heads, self.head_dim)
+        v = self.v(x).view(B, T, self.num_heads, self.head_dim)
+        q, k = (F.rms_norm(q, (q.size(-1),)), F.rms_norm(k, (k.size(-1),)))
+        q, k = (self.rotary(q), self.rotary(k))
+        y = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(
+            q.transpose(1, 2), k.transpose(1, 2), v.transpose(1, 2), scale=0.12, is_causal=True
+        ).transpose(1, 2)
+        y = y.contiguous().view(B, T, self.num_heads * self.head_dim)
+        y = self.proj(y)
+        return y
+
+
+class MLP(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, dim: int):
+        super().__init__()
+        hdim = 4 * dim
+        self.fc = Linear(dim, hdim)
+        self.proj = Linear(hdim, dim)
+
+    def forward(self, x: Tensor):
+        x = self.fc(x)
+        x = x.relu().square()
+        x = self.proj(x)
+        return x
+
+
+class Block(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, dim: int, head_dim=128):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.attn = CausalSelfAttention(dim, head_dim)
+        self.mlp = MLP(dim)
+        self.norm1 = RMSNorm(dim)
+        self.norm2 = RMSNorm(dim)
+
+    def forward(self, x: Tensor):
+        x = x + self.attn(self.norm1(x))
+        x = x + self.mlp(self.norm2(x))
+        return x
+
+
+class GPT(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, vocab_size: int, num_layers: int, model_dim: int, head_dim=128):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.embed = nn.Embedding(vocab_size, model_dim).bfloat16()
+        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList([Block(model_dim, head_dim) for _ in range(num_layers)])
+        self.proj = Linear(model_dim, vocab_size)
+        self.norm1 = RMSNorm(model_dim)
+        self.norm2 = RMSNorm(model_dim)
+
+    def forward(self, inputs: Tensor, targets: Tensor):
+        x = self.norm1(self.embed(inputs))
+        for block in self.blocks:
+            x = block(x)
+        logits = self.proj(self.norm2(x)).float()
+        logits = 15 * logits * (logits.square() + 15**2).rsqrt()
+        return F.cross_entropy(logits.view(targets.numel(), -1), targets.view(-1), reduction="sum")
+
+
+@torch.no_grad()
+def initialize_model(model, seed):
+    if seed:
+        torch.manual_seed(seed)
+    for name, parameter in model.named_parameters():
+        if name.endswith("weight"):
+            if "proj" in name:
+                parameter.zero_()
+            elif "embed" in name:
+                parameter.normal_()
+            else:
+                parameter.normal_(std=0.33**0.5 / parameter.size(-1) ** 0.5)
+        elif name.endswith("bias"):
+            parameter.zero_()
+        elif name.endswith("gains"):
+            parameter.normal_(mean=1, std=0)
+        else:
+            raise ValueError(f"Unknown parameter: {name}")

+"""Optimizer conventions for the nanoGPT reproduction configurations."""
+
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+
+
+def cubic_polar(gradient):
+    x = gradient.bfloat16()
+    transpose = gradient.size(-2) > gradient.size(-1)
+    if transpose:
+        x = x.mT
+    x = x / (x.norm(dim=(-2, -1), keepdim=True) + 1e-7)
+    for _ in range(12):
+        gram = x @ x.mT
+        polynomial = -1.5 * gram + 0.5 * gram @ gram
+        x = 2 * x + polynomial @ x
+    return x.mT if transpose else x
+
+
+@torch.compile
+def update_direction(
+    gradient, momentum_buffer, inner=None, outer=None, momentum=0.95, nesterov=True
+):
+    momentum_buffer.lerp_(gradient, 1 - momentum)
+    update = gradient.lerp_(momentum_buffer, momentum) if nesterov else momentum_buffer
+    if inner is not None:
+        update = update.bfloat16() @ inner
+    update = cubic_polar(update).bfloat16()
+    if outer is not None:
+        update = update @ outer
+    return update.float() * max(1, gradient.size(-2) / gradient.size(-1)) ** 0.5
+
+
+class Muon(torch.optim.Optimizer):
+    def __init__(self, params, lr, weight_decay, momentum=0.95, nesterov=True):
+        super().__init__(
+            sorted(list(params), key=lambda p: p.size(), reverse=True),
+            dict(lr=lr, weight_decay=weight_decay, mu=momentum, nesterov=nesterov),
+        )
+
+    @torch.no_grad()
+    def step(self):
+        world, rank = dist.get_world_size(), dist.get_rank()
+        for group in self.param_groups:
+            params = group["params"]
+            padded = params + [torch.empty_like(params[-1])] * (world - len(params) % world)
+            for first in range(0, len(params), world):
+                if first + rank < len(params):
+                    p = params[first + rank]
+                    state = self.state[p]
+                    if "momentum" not in state:
+                        state["momentum"] = torch.zeros_like(p)
+                    update = update_direction(
+                        p.grad, state["momentum"], None, None, group["mu"], group["nesterov"]
+                    )
+                    p.mul_(1 - group["lr"] * group["weight_decay"])
+                    p.add_(update, alpha=-group["lr"])
+                dist.all_gather(padded[first : first + world], padded[first + rank])
+
+    def close(self):
+        pass
+
+
+def configure_backend(config):
+    import backend
+
+    root = config["root"]
+    names = {
+        "mode": "ROOT_ROOTS",
+        "inner_strength": "ROOT_P_IN",
+        "outer_strength": "ROOT_P_OUT",
+        "decay_strength": "ROOT_P_DECAY",
+        "damping": "ROOT_DAMPING",
+        "iterations": "ROOT_ITERS",
+        "refresh": "ROOT_REFRESH",
+        "inline_steps": "ROOT_INLINE",
+        "tolerance": "ROOT_TOL",
+        "rho_max": "ROOT_RHO_MAX",
+        "sqrt_iterations": "ROOT_SQRT_ITERS",
+        "max_stale_steps": "ROOT_STALE_MAX",
+        "workers": "ROOT_WORKERS",
+        "wide_workers": "ROOT_WIDE_MAX",
+        "graphs": "ROOT_GRAPH",
+        "eigh_threads": "ROOT_EIGH_THREADS",
+    }
+    for key, name in names.items():
+        if key in root:
+            setattr(backend, name, root[key])
+    backend.STATISTIC_MOMENTUM = config["statistics"]["momentum"]
+    backend.GLOBAL_STATISTICS = config["statistics"]["global"]
+    backend.STAT_MODULES.clear()
+    backend._STAT["rows"] = None
+    backend.ROOT_DECAY = "outer"
+    backend._ROOT_D8 = abs(backend.ROOT_P_DECAY * 8 - round(backend.ROOT_P_DECAY * 8)) < 1e-9
+    backend.ROOT_DEC_ROOT = backend.ROOT_P_DECAY if backend._ROOT_D8 else 2 * backend.ROOT_P_DECAY
+    backend.ROOT_USE = sorted(
+        {q for q in (backend.ROOT_P_IN, backend.ROOT_P_OUT, backend.ROOT_DEC_ROOT) if q}
+    )
+    backend.ROOT_POWERS = sorted({p for q in backend.ROOT_USE for p in backend.root_split(q)})
+    return backend
+
+
+def build_optimizers(model, config):
+    opt = config["optimizer"]
+    aux = config["auxiliary"]
+    auxiliary = torch.optim.AdamW(
+        [
+            {"params": [model.embed.weight], "lr": aux["embedding_lr"]},
+            {"params": [model.proj.weight], "lr": aux["head_lr"]},
+            {"params": [p for p in model.parameters() if p.ndim < 2], "lr": aux["scalar_lr"]},
+        ],
+        betas=tuple(aux["betas"]),
+        eps=aux["eps"],
+        weight_decay=aux["weight_decay"],
+        fused=True,
+    )
+    matrices = [p for p in model.blocks.parameters() if p.ndim >= 2]
+    hooks = []
+    if opt["name"] == "muon":
+        body = Muon(matrices, opt["lr"], opt["weight_decay"], opt["momentum"], opt["nesterov"])
+    elif opt["name"] == "muont":
+        backend = configure_backend(config)
+        rank, world = dist.get_rank(), dist.get_world_size()
+        ordered = sorted(matrices, key=lambda p: p.size(), reverse=True)
+        owned = set(ordered[rank::world])
+        sources = {}
+        head, stride = config["statistics"]["head"], config["statistics"]["stride"]
+
+        def record(module, inputs, output):
+            if module.training and torch.is_grad_enabled():
+                with torch.no_grad():
+                    rows = torch.cat(
+                        [inputs[0].detach()[:, :head], inputs[0].detach()[:, head + 1 :: stride]],
+                        dim=1,
+                    ).flatten(0, 1)
+                    module.stat_sum.add_(torch.mm(rows.T, rows, out_dtype=torch.float32))
+                    module.stat_rows.add_(rows.size(0))
+
+        for layer, block in enumerate(model.blocks):
+            a, m = block.attn, block.mlp
+            for kind, hooked, users in [
+                ("attn_in", a.q, (a.q, a.k, a.v)),
+                ("attn_out", a.proj, (a.proj,)),
+                ("mlp_in", m.fc, (m.fc,)),
+                ("mlp_hid", m.proj, (m.proj,)),
+            ]:
+                d = hooked.in_features
+                device = hooked.weight.device
+                hooked.register_buffer(
+                    "stat_sum", torch.zeros(d, d, device=device), persistent=False
+                )
+                hooked.register_buffer(
+                    "stat_rows", torch.zeros((), device=device), persistent=False
+                )
+                if any(u.weight in owned for u in users):
+                    hooked.register_buffer(
+                        "stat_cov", torch.zeros(d, d, device=device), persistent=False
+                    )
+                    hooked.register_buffer(
+                        "stat_weight", torch.zeros((), device=device), persistent=False
+                    )
+                hooked.stat_name = f"{layer}.{kind}"
+                hooks.append(hooked.register_forward_hook(record))
+                backend.STAT_MODULES.append(hooked)
+                sources.update({u.weight: hooked for u in users})
+        body = backend.TonerRunOptimizer(
+            matrices,
+            lr=opt["lr"],
+            weight_decay=opt["weight_decay"],
+            mu=opt["momentum"],
+            nesterov=opt["nesterov"],
+            sources=sources,
+        )
+    else:
+        raise ValueError("optimizer.name must be muon or muont")
+    for optimizer in [auxiliary, body]:
+        for group in optimizer.param_groups:
+            group["initial_lr"] = group["lr"]
+    return auxiliary, body, hooks

+"""Train the configured nanoGPT Muon or MuonT comparison with torchrun."""
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+def lr_scale(step, total_steps, cooldown_fraction):
+    if not 0 <= step < total_steps or not 0 < cooldown_fraction <= 1:
+        raise ValueError("Invalid schedule position or cooldown fraction")
+    progress = step / total_steps
+    return 1.0 if progress < 1 - cooldown_fraction else (1 - progress) / cooldown_fraction
+
+
+def load_config(path):
+    config = json.loads(Path(path).read_text())
+    train = config["training"]
+    opt = config["optimizer"]
+    if train["gradient_reduction"] != "sum" or train["clip_grad_norm"] is not None:
+        raise ValueError("This training recipe uses summed gradients without clipping")
+    if (opt["ns_steps"], opt["ns_coefficients"], opt["ns_epsilon"], opt["ns_dtype"]) != (
+        12,
+        [2.0, -1.5, 0.5],
+        1e-7,
+        "bfloat16",
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("Unsupported Muon numerical recipe")
+    if train["batch_tokens"] % (
+        train["world_size"] * train["sequence_length"] * train["micro_batch_size"]
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("Global batch does not divide into local microbatches")
+    if not config["statistics"]["global"]:
+        raise ValueError("This recipe requires globally pooled statistics")
+    return config
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--config", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--data-dir", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--out", type=Path, default=Path("checkpoints/nanogpt-reproduction"))
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--max-steps",
+        type=int,
+        help="Stop early for an integration check; retain the configured schedule",
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--no-compile", action="store_true", help="Disable model compilation for debugging"
+    )
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    cfg = load_config(args.config)
+    os.environ["OMP_NUM_THREADS"] = str(cfg.get("runtime", {}).get("omp_num_threads", 2))
+    import torch
+    import torch.distributed as dist
+    from model import GPT, initialize_model
+    from optimizer import build_optimizers
+    from data import token_batches
+
+    if not torch.cuda.is_available():
+        parser.error("This reproduction entry point requires CUDA")
+    required = cfg["data"]["files"]
+    for name in required:
+        if not (args.data_dir / name).is_file():
+            parser.error(f"Missing configured shard: {name}")
+    world = int(os.environ.get("WORLD_SIZE", "1"))
+    rank = int(os.environ.get("RANK", "0"))
+    if world != cfg["training"]["world_size"]:
+        parser.error(
+            f"Configuration requires {cfg['training']['world_size']} processes; use torchrun"
+        )
+    device = torch.device("cuda", int(os.environ.get("LOCAL_RANK", "0")))
+    torch.cuda.set_device(device)
+    torch.set_num_threads(int(os.environ["OMP_NUM_THREADS"]))
+    dist.init_process_group(backend="nccl", device_id=device)
+    auxiliary = body = None
+    hooks = []
+    try:
+        train = cfg["training"]
+        evaluation = cfg["evaluation"]
+        total = train["steps"]
+        stop = total if args.max_steps is None else args.max_steps
+        if not 0 < stop <= total:
+            raise ValueError("max-steps must be between1 and the configured step count")
+        sequence = train["sequence_length"]
+        micro = train["micro_batch_size"]
+        val_files = [args.data_dir / name for name in required if name.startswith("fineweb_val_")]
+        train_files = [
+            args.data_dir / name for name in required if name.startswith("fineweb_train_")
+        ]
+        val_tokens = cfg["data"]["validation_tokens"]
+        validation = token_batches(
+            val_files, val_tokens, sequence, world, rank, device, shuffle_seed=0
+        )
+        val_x, val_y = next(validation)
+        model = GPT(**cfg["model"]).to(device)
+        if cfg.get("runtime", {}).get("compile_model", True) and not args.no_compile:
+            model.compile(dynamic=False)
+        initialize_model(model, train.get("seed", 1))
+        auxiliary, body, hooks = build_optimizers(model, cfg)
+        loaders = token_batches(
+            train_files,
+            train["batch_tokens"],
+            sequence,
+            world,
+            rank,
+            device,
+            shuffle_seed=train.get("seed", 1),
+        )
+        for parameter in model.parameters():
+            dist.broadcast(parameter.detach(), 0)
+        args.out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        if rank == 0:
+            (args.out / "config.json").write_text(json.dumps(cfg, indent=2) + "\n")
+            (args.out / "execution.json").write_text(
+                json.dumps(
+                    {
+                        "requested_steps": stop,
+                        "configured_steps": total,
+                        "model_compile": not args.no_compile
+                        and cfg.get("runtime", {}).get("compile_model", True),
+                        "world_size": world,
+                        "torch": torch.__version__,
+                        "device": torch.cuda.get_device_name(device),
+                    },
+                    indent=2,
+                )
+                + "\n"
+            )
+        model.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
+        for step in range(stop + 1):
+            frequency = (
+                evaluation["early_interval"]
+                if step < evaluation["switch_fraction"] * total
+                else evaluation["late_interval"]
+            )
+            if step == stop or step % frequency == 0:
+                dist.barrier()
+                model.eval()
+                if len(val_x) % micro:
+                    raise ValueError("Validation batch must divide into microbatches")
+                loss = torch.zeros((), device=device)
+                with torch.no_grad():
+                    for first in range(0, len(val_x), micro):
+                        loss += model(val_x[first : first + micro], val_y[first : first + micro])
+                dist.all_reduce(loss, op=dist.ReduceOp.SUM)
+                loss /= val_tokens
+                if rank == 0:
+                    print(f"step {step}/{total}: val_loss {loss.item():.5f}", flush=True)
+                    with (args.out / "metrics.jsonl").open("a") as file:
+                        file.write(json.dumps({"step": step, "val_loss": loss.item()}) + "\n")
+                if not torch.isfinite(loss):
+                    raise FloatingPointError("Validation loss is not finite")
+                model.train()
+                dist.barrier()
+            if step == stop:
+                break

+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class ProjectionBlock:
+    """Seven projections of one uniform, bias-free Llama-style block.
+
+    q/k/v must receive the same input tensor, as must gate/up. All layers must
+    share hidden and MLP widths. Biases and non-block parameters are deliberately
+    excluded; update those with the caller's ordinary AdamW optimizer.
+    """
+
+    q: nn.Linear
+    k: nn.Linear
+    v: nn.Linear
+    o: nn.Linear
+    gate: nn.Linear
+    up: nn.Linear
+    down: nn.Linear
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_module(cls, block: nn.Module) -> "ProjectionBlock":
+        """Adapt a block exposing q, k, v, o, gate, up and down attributes."""
+        return cls(**{name: getattr(block, name) for name in cls.__dataclass_fields__})
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class NanoGPTBlock:
+    """Six projections of a uniform modded-nanoGPT block.
+
+    Q/K/V share one input. Attention projection, MLP expansion and MLP
+    projection each have their own input statistic. Biases are allowed but
+    excluded from Toner; give them to the caller's auxiliary optimizer.
+    """
+
+    q: nn.Linear
+    k: nn.Linear
+    v: nn.Linear
+    attn_proj: nn.Linear
+    fc: nn.Linear
+    mlp_proj: nn.Linear
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_module(cls, block: nn.Module) -> "NanoGPTBlock":
+        """Map block.attn.{q,k,v,proj} and block.mlp.{fc,proj}."""
+        return cls(
+            block.attn.q, block.attn.k, block.attn.v, block.attn.proj, block.mlp.fc, block.mlp.proj
+        )
+
+
+# The preserved root kernels use process-global strengths and compiled graphs.
+# Silently mixing configurations could compute the wrong optimizer.
+_ACTIVE = weakref.WeakSet()
+_LLAMA_NAMES = ("q", "k", "v", "o", "gate", "up", "down")
+_NANOGPT_NAMES = ("q", "k", "v", "attn_proj", "fc", "mlp_proj")
+_KINDS = {
+    "q": "attn",
+    "k": "attn",
+    "v": "attn",
+    "o": "o",
+    "gate": "mlp",
+    "up": "mlp",
+    "down": "down",
+    "attn_proj": "o",
+    "fc": "mlp",
+    "mlp_proj": "down",
+}
+_NANOGPT_PATHS = {
+    "q": "attn.q",
+    "k": "attn.k",
+    "v": "attn.v",
+    "attn_proj": "attn.proj",
+    "fc": "mlp.fc",
+    "mlp_proj": "mlp.proj",
+}
+
+

+    if isinstance(block, (ProjectionBlock, NanoGPTBlock)):

+def _adamt(Ps, Gs, m, v, R2, n2, lr, wd, bc1, bc2, b1: float, b2: float, eps: float):
+    """Update AdamT moments and return the parameter change for one matrix-shape group."""
+    P, G = torch.stack(Ps), torch.stack(Gs).float()
+    n = P.size(-1)
+    m = m * b1 + G * (1 - b1)
+    gw = PR.apply16_raw(G, R2)
+    v = v * b2 + gw * gw * (1 - b2)
+    U = PR.apply16_raw(m, R2) / bc1 / ((v / bc2).sqrt() + eps)
+    UR = PR.apply16_raw(U, R2)
+    upd = UR * (
+        U.norm(dim=(-2, -1), keepdim=True) / UR.norm(dim=(-2, -1), keepdim=True).clamp_min(1e-30)
+    )
+    dec = (
+        PR.apply16_raw(PR.apply16_raw(P, R2), R2) * (n / n2)[:, None, None]
+    )  # decay W R^2 / mean diag(R^2)
+    return m, v, -(lr * wd) * dec - lr * upd
+

+def _muont_in(Gs, m, R2, mu: float, nesterov: bool):
+    """MuonT before Newton-Schulz: momentum, and (Nesterov) u R."""
+    G = torch.stack(Gs).float()
+    m = m * mu + G
+    return m, PR.apply16_raw(G + mu * m if nesterov else m, R2)
+

+def _muont_out(Ps, x, R2, n2, lr, wd, scale: float):
+    """MuonT after Newton-Schulz: the parameter change -lr (wd W R^2 n / ||R||_F^2 + scale x R-hat), R-hat =
+    R sqrt(n) / ||R||_F, as one product with R: -(lr wd n / ||R||_F^2 (W R) + lr scale sqrt(n) / ||R||_F x) R (three
+    FP32-accurate R products per matrix with muont_in, instead of four)."""
+    P = torch.stack(Ps)
+    n = P.size(-1)
+    V = ((lr * wd) * (n / n2))[:, None, None] * PR.apply16_raw(P, R2) + (
+        lr * scale * n**0.5 / n2.sqrt().clamp_min(1e-30)
+    )[:, None, None] * x
+    return -PR.apply16_raw(V, R2)
+

+def _muont_out_inner(Ps, x, lr, wd, scale: float):
+    """Inner-root MuonT (--toner-outer 0): Muon's parameter change -lr (wd W + scale x) on X = NS(u R) (no R-hat and

+    return -(lr * wd) * torch.stack(Ps) - (lr * scale) * x

+def layer_counts(L, world, weights=None):
+    """Layers owned by each rank (contiguous blocks): equal, or proportional to `weights` (largest remainder; a zero
+    weight owns nothing). Owners do the roots, EMAs and updates of their layers' statistics and matrices, so a slower
+    GPU can be given less of that work (every rank still computes its rows' partial Grams of every statistic)."""
+    if not weights:

+        return [L // world] * world
+    w = [max(0.0, float(x)) for x in weights]

+    for r in sorted(range(world), key=lambda q: raw[q] - cnt[q], reverse=True)[: L - sum(cnt)]:
+        cnt[r] += 1
+    return cnt

+def offload_plan(world, weights, rows):
+    """Row offload (--toner-offload): the ranks owning no layers (weight 0) send their rows of the offloaded statistic
+    groups to the other ranks (receivers), which add them to their own Grams; an offloader then computes no Gram of
+    those groups and is not in their reduce-scatter. Each offloader's rows [0, rows) are split into contiguous chunks
+    over the receivers in proportion to their weights (largest remainder). Returns None (nothing to offload) or
+    {"offloaders", "receivers", "chunks": {receiver: (lo, hi)}, "extra": {rank: rows received}}."""
+    w = [max(0.0, float(x)) for x in weights] if weights else [1.0] * world

+    if not off or not recv:
+        return None
+    raw = [rows * w[r] / sum(w[q] for q in recv) for r in recv]
+    cnt = [int(x) for x in raw]
+    for i in sorted(range(len(recv)), key=lambda i: raw[i] - cnt[i], reverse=True)[
+        : rows - sum(cnt)
+    ]:

+    lo = [sum(cnt[:i]) for i in range(len(recv))]

+    world = len(counts)

+                            lam.shape[:-1],

+                            device=lam.device,

+                    )
+                    continue

+                lam.shape[:-1], self.args.toner_eps, dtype=torch.float32, device=lam.device

+    def _host_refresh(self, x_in, x_out, tol_out, copied):
+        """Worker thread: exact FP32 eigendecomposition of an owned statistic's snapshot (pinned x_in, once its copy
+        is done) into pinned x_out, and its roots' tolerance into tol_out (0-d view). No other CUDA calls."""
+        torch.set_num_threads(max(1, self.args.toner_host_threads))
+        copied.synchronize()
+        lam, V = torch.linalg.eigh(0.5 * (x_in + x_in.mT))
+        x_out.copy_(V)
+        tol_out.copy_(self._tolerance(lam))
+
+    def _submit_refresh(self, g, j):
+        """Side stream: snapshot of statistic j's EMA into pinned memory, then its exact host eigendecomposition."""
+        g.host_in[j].copy_(g.C[j], non_blocking=True)
+        copied = torch.cuda.Event(blocking=True)
+        copied.record(self.side)
+        g.pending[j] = (
+            self.pool.submit(
+                self._host_refresh, g.host_in[j], g.host_out[j], g.host_tol[j], copied
+            ),
+            self.steps,
+        )
+
+    def _install_ready(self):
+        """Side stream: install the bases whose host decompositions have finished (one masked call per group)."""
+        for g in self.groups.values():
+            if not g.per:
+                continue
+            ready = [j for j in range(g.per) if g.pending[j] is not None and g.pending[j][0].done()]
+            if not ready:
+                continue
+            mask = [False] * g.per
+            for j in ready:
+                g.pending[j][0].result()  # (re-raises a worker's exception)
+                if (
+                    g.pending[j][1] >= g.basis_step[j]
+                ):  # not older than the basis in use (an exact fallback may
+                    g.stage[j].copy_(
+                        g.host_out[j], non_blocking=True
+                    )  # have installed a newer one meanwhile)
+                    g.tol[j].copy_(g.host_tol[j], non_blocking=True)
+                    mask[j] = True
+                    g.basis_step[j] = g.pending[j][1]
+                g.pending[j] = None
+            if any(mask):
+                g.basis.install_many(
+                    g.stage, torch.tensor(mask).pin_memory().to(self.device, non_blocking=True)
+                )

+    def _roots(self, g):
+        """Root candidates of a group from its bases: R, B, the safeguard's flags (no host sync) and the iteration's
+        state (flagged roots continue from it)."""
+        a = self.args
+        B, _ = PR.basis_transform(g.C, g.basis)
+        lam, O, rho, est, state = self.froot.froot_state(B, self.iters, a.toner_freeze)
+        if (
+            self.split
+        ):  # both roots from the same Y, each accepted at its own single-root path's strictness
+            Rp, est_s = PR.form_powers(g.basis, lam, O)
+            bad = (
+                (rho > a.toner_rho_max)
+                | self._split_over(est, est_s, g.tol)
+                | ~torch.isfinite(lam).all(-1)
+            )
+            return (Rp[self.p_in], Rp[self.p_out]), B, bad, state
+        bad = (rho > a.toner_rho_max) | ~(est <= g.tol) | ~torch.isfinite(lam).all(-1)
+        return PR.form(g.basis, lam, O), B, bad, state
+
+    def _split_over(self, est, est_s, tol):
+        """Split roots above their tolerances (no host sync): tol (..., 3) holds each statistic's tolerances of R_1/8,
+        R_1/4 and R_1/2 (_tolerance), est = est(Y). R_1/2: 2 est(Y), as the alpha-1/2 path; R_1/4: est(Y), as the
+        alpha-1/4 path; R_1/8: est(Y) / 2 + est(sqrt)."""
+        over = torch.zeros_like(est, dtype=torch.bool)
+        if 0.5 in PR.POWERS:
+            over |= ~(2 * est <= tol[..., 2])
+        if 0.25 in PR.POWERS:
+            over |= ~(est <= tol[..., 1])
+        if 0.125 in PR.POWERS:
+            over |= ~(0.5 * est + est_s <= tol[..., 0])
+        return over
+
+    def _roots_graphed(self, g):
+        """_roots as a CUDA graph (one launch instead of ~40): eager once (compiles, autotunes), then captured on
+        the side stream and replayed. Its inputs (EMA, bases) are updated in place, so their addresses never change;
+        its outputs live in the graph's pool and are rewritten at every replay (used within the step)."""
+        if not self.args.toner_graphs:
+            return self._roots(g)
+        if not g.warm:
+            g.warm = True
+            return self._roots(g)
+        if g.graph is None:
+            graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+            with torch.cuda.graph(
+                graph, pool=self.graph_pool, stream=self.side, capture_error_mode="thread_local"
+            ):
+                out = self._roots(g)
+            g.graph = (graph,) + out
+        g.graph[0].replay()
+        return g.graph[1:]

+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ roots
+    @torch.no_grad()
+    def begin(self):
+        """This step's statistics and root candidates on the side stream. Call right after the last micro-batch's
+        forward (its rows are then complete), so they overlap its backward; step() finishes the step."""
+        a = self.args
+        tb0 = time.perf_counter()
+        ev_fwd = torch.cuda.Event()
+        ev_fwd.record(self.main_stream)
+        self._ev = [torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True) for _ in range(4)]
+        self.cand, flags = {}, []
+        with torch.cuda.stream(self.side):
+            self.side.wait_event(ev_fwd)
+            self._ev[0].record(self.side)
+            if all(g.basis is not None for g in self.groups.values() if g.per):
+                self._install_ready()
+            tb1 = time.perf_counter()
+            self._stats()
+            self._ev[1].record(self.side)
+            for name, g in self.groups.items():
+                if not g.per:  # this rank owns none of the group's statistics (weighted ownership)
+                    empty = torch.empty(0, g.n, g.n, device=self.device)
+                    self.cand[name] = (
+                        (empty, empty) if self.split else empty,
+                        None,
+                        torch.zeros(0, dtype=torch.bool, device=self.device),
+                        None,
+                    )
+                elif (
+                    g.basis is None or self.steps < a.toner_inline
+                ):  # first steps / after a restart: exact roots
+                    if self.split:
+                        (V, Rp), lam_x = PR.exact_eigh_powers(g.C, True)
+                        R = (Rp[self.p_in], Rp[self.p_out])
+                    else:
+                        (V, R), lam_x = PR.exact_eigh(
+                            g.C, True
+                        )  # (the statistic moves fastest at the start)
+                    g.tol.copy_(self._tolerance(lam_x))
+                    if g.basis is None:
+                        g.basis = PR.Basis(V)
+                    else:
+                        for j in range(g.per):
+                            g.basis.install(j, V[j])
+                    g.basis_step = [self.steps] * g.per
+                    g.pending = [None] * g.per
+                    self.cand[name] = (
+                        R,
+                        None,
+                        torch.zeros(g.per, dtype=torch.bool, device=self.device),
+                        None,
+                    )
+                else:
+                    self.cand[name] = self._roots_graphed(g)
+                flags.append(self.cand[name][2])
+            tb2 = time.perf_counter()
+            self.flags_host.copy_(torch.cat(flags).to(torch.uint8), non_blocking=True)
+            self.ev_flags = torch.cuda.Event()
+            self.ev_flags.record(self.side)
+            for g in self.groups.values():
+                for j in range(g.per):
+                    if (
+                        g.pending[j] is None
+                        and (self.steps + j) % self.refresh == 0
+                        and g.basis_step[j] != self.steps
+                    ):
+                        self._submit_refresh(g, j)
+            self._ev[2].record(self.side)
+            self.ev_done = torch.cuda.Event()
+            self.ev_done.record(self.side)
+        for name, (
+            R,
+            B,
+            _,
+            _,
+        ) in self.cand.items():  # used next on the main stream: keep their memory until those
+            if self.groups[name].graph is None:  # uses finish (graph outputs are never freed)

+                    t.record_stream(self.main_stream)

+                    B.record_stream(self.main_stream)

+            self.main_stream.wait_stream(self.side)
+        self.begun = True
+        tb3 = time.perf_counter()
+        self.begin_timing = {
+            "install_host": tb1 - tb0,
+            "stats_roots_host": tb2 - tb1,
+            "snap_host": tb3 - tb2,
+        }

+    def _finish_roots(self):
+        """Refine flagged factors on the side stream, then use exact fallback where needed."""
+        a = self.args

+                        )

+                                PR.Basis.of_splits(g.basis.S2.index_select(0, idx)), lam, O

+                            R2 = (Rp2[self.p_in], Rp2[self.p_out])

+                                (rho <= a.toner_rho_max)
+                                & ~self._split_over(est, est_s, g.tol.index_select(0, idx))

+                            ).tolist()
+                        else:
+                            R2 = PR.form(
+                                PR.Basis.of_splits(g.basis.S2.index_select(0, idx)), lam, O
+                            )
+                            okl = (
+                                (rho <= a.toner_rho_max)
+                                & (est <= g.tol.index_select(0, idx))
+                                & torch.isfinite(lam).all(-1)
+                            ).tolist()

+                                    if R[1] is not R[0]:
+                                        R[1][j].copy_(R2[1][i])
+                                else:
+                                    R[j].copy_(R2[i])

+                        hopeless += [j for i, j in enumerate(still) if not okl[i] and not rhok[i]]
+                        cur = (pad, (lam, O, dl))
+                        still = [j for i, j in enumerate(still) if not okl[i] and rhok[i]]

+                        still

+                            1  # refresh still running for j is discarded when it lands: older)
+                        )
+                        if self.split:
+                            (V, Rxp), lam_x = PR.exact_eigh_powers(g.C[j : j + 1], True)
+                            g.tol[j : j + 1].copy_(self._tolerance(lam_x))
+                            R[0][j].copy_(Rxp[self.p_in][0])
+                            if R[1] is not R[0]:
+                                R[1][j].copy_(Rxp[self.p_out][0])
+                        else:
+                            (V, Rx), lam_x = PR.exact_eigh(g.C[j : j + 1], True)
+                            g.tol[j : j + 1].copy_(self._tolerance(lam_x))
+                            R[j].copy_(Rx[0])
+                        g.basis.install(j, V[0])
+                        g.basis_step[j] = self.steps

+                        self.refresh_flagged
+                    ):  # converged with more iterations from an old basis: refresh that basis
+                        for j in (
+                            flagged
+                        ):  # now rather than at its turn (the next steps then need no extra work)
+                            if j not in still and g.pending[j] is None:
+                                self._submit_refresh(g, j)
+            self.main_stream.wait_stream(self.side)
+        else:
+            self.main_stream.wait_event(self.ev_done)
+        if (
+            a.toner_check_every and self.steps % a.toner_check_every == 0
+        ):  # validation only: an eigh per statistic
+            for name, Rr in roots.items():
+                g = self.groups[name]
+                if not g.per:
+                    continue
+                if self.split:  # both roots: name (inner), name_out (outer)
+                    _, Rxp = PR.exact_eigh_powers(g.C)

+    @torch.no_grad()
+    def step(self):

+        if (
+            self._ev_last is not None and self._ev_last[3].query()
+        ):  # the last step's GPU phase times (ms)
+            e = self._ev_last
+            self.gpu_ms = {
+                "stats": e[0].elapsed_time(e[1]),
+                "roots": e[1].elapsed_time(e[2]),
+                "update": e[2].elapsed_time(e[3]),
+            }
+        t0 = time.perf_counter()
+        if not self.begun:  # begin() was not called after the last forward: do it here
+            self.begin()
+        self.begun = False
+        roots = self._finish_roots()
+        t1 = time.perf_counter()
+        # per owned statistic: its R and ||R||_F^2 (R-hat's scale; mean diag R^2 = ||R||_F^2 / n); split: R_in, then
+        # R_out and ||R_out||_F^2 (the outer factor's R-hat and decay)
+        Rof = {}
+        for name, g in self.groups.items():
+            if self.split:
+                Ri, Ro = roots[name]
+                nrm2 = Ro.square().sum((-2, -1))
+                for j, key in enumerate(g.own):
+                    Rof[key] = (Ri[j], nrm2[j], Ro[j])
+                continue
+            R = roots[name]
+            nrm2 = R.square().sum((-2, -1))
+            for j, key in enumerate(g.own):

+                st = self.state.setdefault(shape, {})

+                if "m" not in st:

+                        grads, st["m"], R2, a.muon_momentum, bool(a.muon_nesterov)
+                    )
+                    x = MU.newton_schulz_batched(uR, a.muon_ns_steps, a.muon_eps, a.muon_ns_mode)
+                    if self.split:  # the outer factor's root: X = NS(u R_in) R_out-hat, decay W R_out^2 / mean diag
+                        R2o = PR.rows_lo(torch.stack([Rof[self.stat_of[q]][2] for q in mine]))
+                        delta = muont_out(
+                            mine, x, R2o, n2, lr_t, wd_t, max(1.0, shape[0] / shape[1]) ** 0.5
+                        )
+                    elif a.toner_outer:
+                        delta = muont_out(
+                            mine, x, R2, n2, lr_t, wd_t, max(1.0, shape[0] / shape[1]) ** 0.5

+                        grads,

+                        st["v"],
+                        R2,
+                        n2,
+                        lr_t,
+                        wd_t,

+                        bc2,

+                        a.beta2,
+                        a.eps,

+            deltas.append((ps, per_rank, delta))
+            if self.world > 1:

+                    gather_uneven(delta, [len(x) for x in per_rank], group=self.pg, async_op=True)

+            else:

+        self._ev_last = self._ev

+    @torch.no_grad()
+    def full_state(self):

+        self.main_stream.wait_stream(self.side)

+            full = torch.cat(gather_uneven(g.C, g.counts)[1]) if self.world > 1 else g.C
+            if self.rank == 0:

+                    ema[f"{i}.{k}"] = c.cpu()

+            for key in keys:

+                mine = (
+                    st[key]

+                    else torch.empty((0,) + tuple(shape), device=self.device)

+    @torch.no_grad()
+    def snapshot(self, layers):
+        """Collective: return bias-corrected statistics for selected layers on rank zero."""
+        self.main_stream.wait_stream(self.side)
+        out = {}
+        for g in self.groups.values():
+            full = torch.cat(gather_uneven(g.C, g.counts)[1]) if self.world > 1 else g.C
+            if self.rank == 0:
+                for (i, k), c in zip(g.keys, full.unbind(0)):

+    @torch.no_grad()
+    def load_full_state(self, sd):
+        """Every rank picks its owned statistics and moments by name (any world size)."""
+        for g in self.groups.values():
+            for j, (i, k) in enumerate(g.own):

+@triton.jit
+def _symmetric(
+    A,
+    BB,
+    Lam,
+    O,
+    D,
+    E,
+    P,
+    EP,
+    L0,
+    Sq,
+    Small,
+    Out,
+    OutHalf,
+    Lout,
+    Dparts,
+    N: tl.constexpr,
+    NT: tl.constexpr,

+    BM: tl.constexpr,

+import torch

+ABC = (3.4445, -4.7750, 2.0315)

+def _mm(x, y, mode):
+    if mode == "tpu":
+        return torch.mm(x.to(torch.bfloat16), y.to(torch.bfloat16), out_dtype=torch.float32)
+    return x @ y
+

+def newton_schulz(u, steps, eps, mode="tpu"):
+    a, b, c = ABC
+    x = u.float()
+    x = x / (torch.linalg.matrix_norm(x) + eps)
+    if mode == "bf16":
+        x = x.to(torch.bfloat16)
+    tr = x.size(0) > x.size(1)
+    if tr:
+        x = x.T
+    for _ in range(steps):
+        A = _mm(x, x.T, mode)
+        x = a * x + _mm(b * A + c * _mm(A, A, mode), x, mode)
+    return (x.T if tr else x).float()
+
+
+def _bmm(x, y, mode):
+    if mode == "tpu":
+        return torch.bmm(x.to(torch.bfloat16), y.to(torch.bfloat16), out_dtype=torch.float32)

+    if mode == "bf16":
+        x = x.to(torch.bfloat16)
+    tr = x.size(-2) > x.size(-1)
+    if tr:
+        x = x.transpose(-2, -1)
+    for _ in range(steps):
+        A = _bmm(x, x.transpose(-2, -1), mode)
+        x = a * x + _bmm(b * A + c * _bmm(A, A, mode), x, mode)
+    return (x.transpose(-2, -1) if tr else x).float()

+def _syrk_kernel(X, S, R, n, nt, sxb, sxr, ssb, ssr, BM: tl.constexpr, BK: tl.constexpr):
+    b = tl.program_id(0)
+    t = tl.program_id(1)
+    # tile index t -> (i, j) with i <= j, row-major over the upper triangle
+    i = 0
+    rem = t
+    while rem >= nt - i:
+        rem -= nt - i
+        i += 1
+    j = i + rem
+    offs_m = i * BM + tl.arange(0, BM)
+    offs_n = j * BM + tl.arange(0, BM)
+    offs_k = tl.arange(0, BK)
+    acc = tl.zeros((BM, BM), dtype=tl.float32)
+    xb = X + b * sxb
+    for r in range(0, R, BK):
+        rows = r + offs_k
+        a = tl.load(xb + rows[:, None] * sxr + offs_m[None, :], mask=rows[:, None] < R, other=0.0)
+        c = tl.load(xb + rows[:, None] * sxr + offs_n[None, :], mask=rows[:, None] < R, other=0.0)
+        acc = tl.dot(tl.trans(a), c, acc)
+    sb = S + b * ssb
+    tl.store(sb + offs_m[:, None] * ssr + offs_n[None, :], acc)
+    if i != j:
+        tl.store(sb + offs_n[:, None] * ssr + offs_m[None, :], tl.trans(acc))

+@triton.jit

+    rem = t
+    while rem >= nt - i:
+        rem -= nt - i
+        i += 1
+    j = i + rem
+    offs_m = i * BM + tl.arange(0, BM)
+    offs_n = j * BM + tl.arange(0, BM)
+    offs_k = tl.arange(0, BK)
+    acc = tl.zeros((BM, BM), dtype=tl.float32)
+    xb = X0 + tl.multiple_of(tl.load(OFFS + b), 256)
+    for r in range(0, R, BK):
+        rows = r + offs_k
+        a = tl.load(xb + rows[:, None] * sxr + offs_m[None, :], mask=rows[:, None] < R, other=0.0)
+        c = tl.load(xb + rows[:, None] * sxr + offs_n[None, :], mask=rows[:, None] < R, other=0.0)
+        acc = tl.dot(tl.trans(a), c, acc)
+    sb = S + b * ssb
+    tl.store(sb + offs_m[:, None] * ssr + offs_n[None, :], acc)
+    if i != j:
+        tl.store(sb + offs_n[:, None] * ssr + offs_m[None, :], tl.trans(acc))

+        nt,
+        ntt,

+@triton.jit
+def _syrk_packed_kernel(

+    t = tl.program_id(0) % ntt

+    rem = t
+    while rem >= nt - i:
+        rem -= nt - i
+        i += 1
+    j = i + rem
+    m = i * BM + tl.arange(0, BM)

+    for r in range(tl.cdiv(R, BK)):

+def _syrk_packed_rect_kernel(

+# Muon numerical routines adapted from Levanter (Apache-2.0).
+"""Input factors and finite Newton–Schulz operations used by Toner."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import torch
+from torch import Tensor
+
+_NS_COEFFICIENTS = (3.4445, -4.7750, 2.0315)
+
+
+def _mm(left: Tensor, right: Tensor, mode: str) -> Tensor:
+    if mode == "tpu":
+        if left.device.type != "cuda":
+            raise ValueError("ns_mode='tpu' requires CUDA; use ns_mode='f32' for the CPU reference")
+
+        # and return FP32. Casting a BF16 output to FP32 is NOT equivalent.
+        return torch.mm(left.to(torch.bfloat16), right.to(torch.bfloat16), out_dtype=torch.float32)
+    return left @ right
+
+
+def newton_schulz(matrix: Tensor, steps: int = 10, eps: float = 1e-5, mode: str = "tpu") -> Tensor:
+    """finite polar approximation for a single 2-D matrix.
+
+    ``tpu`` uses BF16 operands with FP32 accumulation/output on CUDA, as in
+    CUDA. ``f32`` is the full-FP32 reference. ``bf16`` keeps
+    the iteration in BF16 and is a different numerical configuration.
+    """
+    if matrix.ndim != 2:
+        raise ValueError("newton_schulz expects a 2-D matrix")
+    if mode not in {"tpu", "f32", "bf16"}:
+        raise ValueError("mode must be 'tpu', 'f32', or 'bf16'")
+    if isinstance(steps, bool) or not isinstance(steps, int) or steps < 1:
+        raise ValueError("steps must be a positive integer")
+    if eps <= 0:
+        raise ValueError("eps must be positive")
+    if mode == "tpu" and matrix.device.type != "cuda":
+        raise ValueError("ns_mode='tpu' requires CUDA; use ns_mode='f32' for the CPU reference")
+    with torch.autocast(device_type=matrix.device.type, enabled=False):
+        a, b, c = _NS_COEFFICIENTS
+        x = matrix.float()
+        x = x / (torch.linalg.matrix_norm(x) + eps)
+        if mode == "bf16":
+            x = x.to(torch.bfloat16)
+        transpose = x.size(0) > x.size(1)
+        if transpose:
+            x = x.T
+        for _ in range(steps):
+            gram = _mm(x, x.T, mode)
+            x = a * x + _mm(b * gram + c * _mm(gram, gram, mode), x, mode)
+        return (x.T if transpose else x).float()
+
+
+def input_factors(
+    covariance: Tensor,
+    inner_strength: float,
+    outer_strength: float,
+    damping: float,
+) -> tuple[Tensor, Tensor, Tensor]:
+    """Return unnormalized inner/outer factors and normalized outer-square decay.
+
+    Symmetrization, eigenvalue clipping, trace-relative damping and the FP64
+    eigensolver fallback follow the reference ``TonerStats._root_batch``.
+    The inner factor remains unnormalized, including for AdamT's moments.
+    """
+    if covariance.ndim != 2 or covariance.shape[0] != covariance.shape[1]:
+        raise ValueError("input covariance must be square")
+    if inner_strength < 0 or outer_strength < 0 or damping <= 0:
+        raise ValueError("strengths must be nonnegative and damping positive")
+    with torch.autocast(device_type=covariance.device.type, enabled=False):
+        c = covariance.float()
+        c = 0.5 * (c + c.T)
+        try:
+            eigenvalues, eigenvectors = torch.linalg.eigh(c)
+        except RuntimeError:
+            eigenvalues, eigenvectors = torch.linalg.eigh(c.double())
+            eigenvalues, eigenvectors = eigenvalues.float(), eigenvectors.float()
+        eigenvalues = eigenvalues.clamp_min(0)
+        unit = eigenvalues / eigenvalues.mean().clamp_min(1e-30)
+        inner_values = (unit + damping).pow(-inner_strength)
+        inner = (eigenvectors * inner_values.unsqueeze(-2)) @ eigenvectors.T
+        if inner_strength == outer_strength:
+            outer_values, outer = inner_values, inner
+        else:
+            outer_values = (unit + damping).pow(-outer_strength)
+            outer = (eigenvectors * outer_values.unsqueeze(-2)) @ eigenvectors.T
+        decay = (eigenvectors * outer_values.square().unsqueeze(-2)) @ eigenvectors.T
+        decay = decay / decay.diagonal().mean()
+        return inner, outer, decay

+        not isinstance(value, (int, float))
+        or not math.isfinite(value)
+        or value < lower

+            _finite_number("weight_decay", group["weight_decay"])
+            _finite_number("statistic_momentum", group["statistic_momentum"], upper=1)
+            _finite_number("damping", group["damping"], lower=1e-30)
+            for parameter in group["params"]:

+                    raise ValueError(
+                        "Toner expects nonempty 2-D matrix weights; optimize other parameters separately"
+                    )

+                        "The reference matches the FP32 master weights; use FP32 parameters"
+                    )

+                    raise ValueError("The reference supports CPU and CUDA parameters")

+        """Update the input EMA once from each parameter's current-step mean Gram.

+        activations, including all accumulated microbatches and ranks. It is an
+        uncentered second moment, not a centered covariance. This method does
+        not all-reduce. Calling it twice without ``step()`` is an error.
+        """
+        groups = {parameter: group for group in self.param_groups for parameter in group["params"]}
+        # Validate the complete input before changing any statistic state.
+        for parameter, covariance in second_moments.items():
+            if parameter not in groups:
+                raise ValueError("Received a statistic for a parameter not owned by this optimizer")

+                )

+            state, beta = self.state[parameter], groups[parameter]["statistic_momentum"]
+            if "input_ema" not in state:
+                state["input_ema"] = torch.zeros_like(covariance, dtype=torch.float32)
+                state["input_weight"] = 0.0

+            state["input_weight"] = beta * state["input_weight"] + (1 - beta)
+            state["statistics_ready"] = True

+

+    evaluation are excluded unless explicitly captured. Call ``commit`` once

+    then positions head+1, head+1+stride, ... in each sequence.

+            # actually used by its GEMM, not an unrounded FP32 norm output.
+            if torch.is_autocast_enabled(x.device.type):
+                x = x.to(torch.get_autocast_dtype(x.device.type))
+            x = x.reshape(-1, x.shape[-1])
+            if not x.shape[0]:
+                raise ValueError(f"{name}: cannot estimate a statistic from zero rows.")
+            # Autocast must not silently lower the accumulation precision.
+            with torch.autocast(device_type=x.device.type, enabled=False):
+                if x.is_cuda and x.dtype == torch.bfloat16:
+                    gram = torch.mm(x.T, x, out_dtype=torch.float32)
+                else:
+                    xf = x.float()
+                    gram = xf.T @ xf
+            if name not in self._sums:
+                self._sums[name] = gram
+                self._counts[name] = x.shape[0]
+            else:
+                self._sums[name].add_(gram)
+                self._counts[name] += x.shape[0]
+
+        return collect
+
+    @contextmanager
+    def capture(self):
+        """Capture one forward; errors discard the whole pending step."""
+        if self._closed:
+            raise RuntimeError("The statistic collector is closed.")
+        if self._active:
+            raise RuntimeError("Nested capture contexts would double-count activations.")
+        self._active = True
+        try:
+            yield self
+        except BaseException:
+            # A failed forward may have captured only part of the model. Discard
+            # the entire pending step rather than contaminate a retry.
+            self._active = False
+            self.clear()
+            raise
+        finally:
+            self._active = False
+
+    @torch.no_grad()
+    def commit(self, optimizer):
+        """Pool rows, update optimizer statistic EMAs once, and clear captures.
+
+        With DDP, every rank must call this with the same registered layers.
+        The caller must synchronize gradients separately (e.g. through DDP).
+        """
+        if self._active:
+            raise RuntimeError("Exit capture() before committing statistics.")
+        if self._closed:
+            raise RuntimeError("The statistic collector is closed.")
+        missing = [name for name in self.layers if name not in self._sums]
+        if missing:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"No captured inputs for: {', '.join(missing)}")
+        means = {}
+        for name, layer in self.layers.items():
+            gram = self._sums[name].clone()
+            count = torch.tensor(self._counts[name], device=gram.device, dtype=torch.int64)
+            if self.distributed and dist.is_available() and dist.is_initialized():
+                dist.all_reduce(gram, group=self.process_group)
+                dist.all_reduce(count, group=self.process_group)
+            means[layer.weight] = gram / count.to(dtype=gram.dtype)
+        optimizer.update_statistics(means)
+        self.clear()
+
+    def clear(self):
+        """Discard captured rows, for example after skipping a training step."""
+        if self._active:
+            raise RuntimeError("Cannot clear statistics during capture.")
+        self._sums.clear()
+        self._counts.clear()
+
+    def close(self):
+        for handle in self._handles:
+            handle.remove()
+        self._handles.clear()
+        self.clear()
+        self._closed = True
